title: Replay of a remaining suffix
statement: Let $x$ and $P,R,O$ be Boolean words, and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions. Starting with the replay machine live, its work tape holding $PR$ and its head at cell $|P|$, and output $O$, after exactly $|R|+1$ steps it is halted with its work tape still holding $PR$, its head at cell $|PR|$, and output $OR$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean input x and words P, R, and O
replaced:
Let $p$ and $r$ be Boolean words and let an output prefix be given. After running the
one-tape replay machine for exactly $|r| + 1$ steps from its live state at cell $|p|$ of
the buffer tape holding $p$ followed by $r$, the machine is halted with the head at cell
$|p| + |r|$, the stored word is unchanged, and the output is extended by exactly $r$ in
order.
